name: Workspace packages
responsibility: Reusable libraries that the applications reach only through their package exports.
description: A package owns one behavior and names its public files in package.json exports; nothing imports an app. Each package sits in a layer: the longest chain of packages it imports. A package imports only layers below its own, and packages of one layer never import each other (tests/system/repository-policy/package-graph.test.ts holds both rules). The apps share layer 8 above them all.
